title: 整数提升与隐式类型转换陷阱
expected_output:
=== integer promotion and usual arithmetic conversions ===

[1] signed meets unsigned
    (int)-1 > (unsigned)1        -> TRUE (!)
    (unsigned)-1                 = 4294967295
    reason: -1 is converted to UINT_MAX before the comparison

[2] char signedness is implementation-defined
    (char)200        = -56
    (signed char)200 = -56
    (unsigned char)200 = 200

[3] short is promoted to int BEFORE the arithmetic
    (short)30000 + (short)30000 = 60000   (int math, no overflow here)
    cast back to short          = -5536   (60000 - 65536)

[4] sizeof and unsigned underflow
    sizeof(int)=4 sizeof(1)=4 sizeof(1u)=4
    (unsigned)0 - 1u = 4294967295   (wraps, never -1)

[5] shifting
    1u << 31 = 2147483648 = 0x80000000
    1  << 31 would be UB (signed overflow)

[6] integer division truncates toward zero
    -7 / 2 = -3    -7 % 2 = -1
    7 / -2 = -3     7 % -2 = 1   (remainder takes the dividend's sign)
